name: UGC Phase 4 — Delivery (Google Docs + ClickUp + Client)

parameters.content:
## WORKFLOW 4: DELIVERY

Webhook POST /ugc-delivery with { project_id, action, script_ids, notes }

IF action = approve:
1. Read approved scripts from Airtable
2. Format scripts (same formatting logic as original)
3. Write to Google Docs
4. Update ClickUp tasks
5. Update Project status to Delivered
6. Update script records (overall_status: Delivered)
7. Slack notification to PM + channel
8. Log to Google Sheets
9. Respond to webhook

IF action = reject:
1. Store revision notes in Airtable
2. Trigger re-write (HTTP request back to Workflow 3)
3. Slack notification

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { body: { project_id: 'rec_TEST_123', action: 'approve', script_ids: [], notes: '' } } }];

parameters.content:
## APPROVE BRANCH
Format scripts -> Google Docs -> ClickUp
-> Update Airtable -> Slack -> Log -> Respond

parameters.jsCode: return [$input.first()];
return [{ json: { _skip: true } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ values: [[ new Date().toISOString(), $('Prepare Notification').first().json.client_code, $('Prepare Notification').first().json.brand_name, 'Delivered', String($('Prepare Notification').first().json.total_scripts), 'N/A', '0', $('Prepare Notification').first().json.script_summary ]] }) }}

parameters.content:
## REJECT BRANCH
Store revision notes -> Trigger re-write
-> Slack notification

parameters.text: ={{ `PM rejected scripts for ${$('Merge Delivery Context').first().json.project.brand_name || 'project'}. Revision notes: ${$('Merge Delivery Context').first().json.notes || 'No notes provided'}. Re-write triggered automatically.` }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'reject', project_id: $('Merge Delivery Context').first().json.project_id, message: 'Scripts rejected. Revision notes stored. Re-write workflow triggered.' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ insertText: { location: { index: $json.body.content.slice(-1)[0].endIndex - 1 }, text: $('Build Doc Requests').first().json.after_text } }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## SEND TO CLIENT BRANCH
Share Google Docs with client
Update scripts to Client Review
Notify PM via Slack

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'send_to_client', project_id: $('Merge Delivery Context').first().json.project_id, message: 'Scripts sent to client for review. Status updated to Client Review.' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: "phase_4", event_type: "phase_complete", project_id: $json.project_id || "", brand_name: $json.brand_name || "", client_code: $json.client_code || "", severity: "info", message: "Delivery complete for " + $json.brand_name, payload: JSON.stringify({ project_id: $json.project_id, client_code: $json.client_code, total_scripts: $json.total_scripts }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}
